system.docHtml:
The caster attunes their senses to the subtle currents of arcane energy that permeate the world, and the invisible becomes faintly visible. Active enchantments glow with soft haloes of color — each school and tradition carrying its own distinctive hue and texture. Dormant magical traps pulse with contained potential, their trigger boundaries limned in faint tracery. Even the residual traces of recently cast spells linger as ghostly afterimages.

This heightened perception extends beyond mere detection; an experienced caster can read the character of what they perceive, distinguishing protective wards from offensive traps, identifying the approximate strength of an enchantment, and sometimes recognizing the casting style of a familiar practitioner. The spell reveals only magic, however — a mundane pit trap or a purely mechanical lock remains invisible to Seek's arcane sight.
